one_idea.line: Yes. Each real page is one readable page held still. Short proof and lines share the headline card, whose standfirst ('break down all the items on the bill') is what he means by 'line by line'. l_code shows the headline naming 'duplicative charges, improper coding', which is what he explains. l_krafton shows the court quoting the CEO's AI chats. No card adds a second idea.

no_invented_numbers.line: No invented figure. th_head, l_head and l_lede show $195,000 and $33,000 printed on the Tom's Hardware page itself. l_krafton shows '258 days', printed on the Harvard Law forum page shown as itself, which the never-list allows. The counters show only the bill-billed and bill-after rows. No slam word or tape has a digit.
